triggers.description: Witnessed falsification evidence needs source-bound classification.
Multiple finding rows may witness one stable law-and-boundary class.
A successor Goal must carry unresolved accepted and blocked Counterexamples plus follow-up classes brought into scope without laundering or losing their lineage.

routes.description: Block when source, validity, applicability, ownership, or subject identity is unknown.

success_signals: claims facts and suggested repairs are separate
supporting_refs contains the exact current goal-contract artifact
a clean source is representable without invented findings
failure_signals: a Set is indistinguishable between predecessor and successor Goal authority
unknown or stale evidence is treated as current
clauses.rationale: Classification remains evidence and never becomes mutation authority.

success_signals: recurrence across Constructions retains stable class identity
failure_signals: attempt commit publication epoch or patch proposal defines class identity
a repair or next action is selected
clauses.rationale: Actuating evaluates stable falsifiers rather than a patch queue.

required_artifacts: every Set carrying an unresolved accepted or blocked class or a follow-up class brought into scope
disposition for every carried stable class
success_signals: successor Goal and successor Set cite the same carried Sets
successor Set cites the exact successor Goal
predecessor Construction remains the classified subject
every carried class appears exactly once with a current disposition
failure_signals: stable goal_id substitutes for exact Goal artifact identity
a carried Set or class is omitted
carry-forward selects a Construction or grants mutation
clauses.rationale: Source revision changes semantic authority without laundering unresolved evidence or manufacturing a repair.

instrumentation.rationale: The immutable Counterexample Set already records every disposition and quotient class consumed by Actuating.
